Acquired June 17, 2025 via Calibre acquisition. Acquired June 17, 2025 via Calibre; sold October 1, 2025. 11,877 oz produced during ownership period (26,138 oz for full nine months to Sept 30, 2025 including pre-acquisition). Costs are for the ownership period. Grade is nine-month average stacked grade.
